description: Selects WinUI code review for the requested editor despite a WPF sibling in the monorepo.
prompt: Can you review Opaline Studio's editor change before I approve it? I'm worried about the title binding, event subscription, and that delete button. Both the editor and exporter files are attached.

paraphrases.novice: Please check the Opaline Studio editor code before we accept it. Will the title update properly, can the events keep old screens alive, and will people understand the delete button?
paraphrases.terse: Opaline editor review: title binding, event lifetime, delete-button accessibility.
